notes:
CIRCUIT: a 5-column x 3-rail passive ladder. Left column carries V-AC (8V/1kHz, #3) between the top rail and the middle rail, and I-DC (3A, #13) between the middle rail and the bottom rail. Four more columns (x~300 col B, x~465 col C, x~690 col D, x~878 col E) each carry an upper diode/zener between the top and middle rails and a lower diode/zener between the middle and bottom rails. Series elements sit IN the rails and split them: C 15uF (#0) in the top rail at x~577; C 9uF (#7) at x~366 and L 4uH (#6) at x~767 in the middle rail; C 1uF (#16) at x~248 and L 1uH (#15) at x~582 in the bottom rail. The middle rail runs past col E to x~984, then down through R 24ohm (#8) to GND (#14).

NET MAP (9 nets, 17 components, 33 terminals):
  n1 = top rail LEFT of the 15uF cap: V-AC top (3.0), zener #5 top (5.1), diode #4 top (4.0), C15uF left (0.0).
  n2 = top rail RIGHT of the 15uF cap: C15uF right (0.1), zener #2 top (2.1), diode #1 top (1.1), including the right-hand corner down to diode #1.
  n3 = middle rail RIGHT of the 4uH inductor: L4uH right (6.1), col-E crossing at S22 -> diode #1 bottom (1.0) and diode #9 top (9.1), continuing right to R24 top (8.0).
  n4 = middle rail BETWEEN the 9uF cap and the 4uH inductor: C9uF right (7.1), col-C crossing S20 -> diode #4 bottom (4.1) and zener #10 top (10.1), col-D crossing S21 -> zener #2 bottom (2.0) and diode #11 top (11.1), L4uH left (6.0). 6 terminals.
  n5 = middle rail LEFT of the 9uF cap: V-AC bottom (3.1), I-DC top (13.0), col-B crossing S19 -> zener #5 bottom (5.0) and diode #12 top (12.0), C9uF left (7.0).
  n6 = bottom rail RIGHT of the 1uH inductor: L1uH right (15.1), diode #11 bottom (11.0) at S40, diode #9 bottom (9.0) at S45.
  n7 = bottom rail BETWEEN the 1uF cap and the 1uH inductor: C1uF right (16.1), diode #12 bottom (12.1) at S41, zener #10 bottom (10.0) at S43, L1uH left (15.0).
  n8 = bottom rail LEFT of the 1uF cap: I-DC bottom (13.1), C1uF left (16.0).
  0  = GND net: R24 bottom (8.1), GND symbol (14.0).

SITE DECISIONS (every CRITICAL site given an explicit reading):
  S0 (295,192) T, top rail / col B top: JUNCTION. Clean T, one wire ends on the other. Nothing else is possible.
  S1 (455,194) T, top rail / col C top: JUNCTION. Clean T.
  S2 (693,195) T, top rail / col D top: JUNCTION. Clean T.
  S17 (77,438) T, left column / left end of the middle rail: JUNCTION. Clean T; the middle rail starts here. A 'crossing' reading is impossible at a degree-3 T and would leave the whole middle rail with no path to V-AC/I-DC.
  S19 (280,454) X, col B crossing the middle rail: JUNCTION (agrees with default). Plain X in the crop - no solder dot (dot=1.6, i.e. bare stroke width) and no hop/jog. Per the dataset ink prior a bare crossing is a real junction. The other reading would put zener #5 bottom and diode #12 top on a private 2-terminal net and strand the C9uF-left end of the middle rail.
  S20 (465,458) X, col C crossing the middle rail: JUNCTION (agrees with default). Plain X, no dot, no hop. The reported hop=9.3 is spurious - the score is picking up the '9 uF' caption ink and the 9uF capacitor plates ~90px to the left, not a wire arc; the crop shows a straight rail through a straight column.
  S21 (688,467) X, col D crossing the middle rail: JUNCTION - OVERRIDE, the tracer defaulted to 'crossing'. The crop shows a completely plain X: rail straight through, column straight through, no dot, no hop, no jog. The default came from hop=7.1, but the arc that produced that score is the FIRST COIL BUMP OF THE 4uH INDUCTOR (#6), whose bounding box starts at x=707, only 19 px right of the crossing at x=688 (confirmed in the S30 crop and in the #6 component crop, where the column is visibly a separate stroke to the left of the coil). It is symbol ink, not a wire hopping the rail. Consequence of the other (crossing) reading: zener #2 bottom + diode #11 top would form an isolated 2-terminal net, and col D would be the only ladder column not tied to the middle rail - inconsistent with the four identical columns beside it, all of which cross with the same plain X.
  S22 (879,474) X, col E crossing the middle rail: JUNCTION (agrees with default). Plain X, no dot, no hop; hop=3.6 again comes from the 4uH coil / '2h' caption nearby. Crossing would isolate diode #1 bottom + diode #9 top and leave R24 fed only through the 4uH inductor.
  S40 (690,771) T, col D / bottom rail: JUNCTION. Clean T.
  S41 (334,773) T, col B / bottom rail: JUNCTION. The column overshoots the rail by ~8 px (that stub is why the tracer calls it deg=4); the stub is a dead end so the junction reading merges all branches correctly.
  S43 (471,777) T, col C / bottom rail: JUNCTION. Clean T with a small ink blob at the corner.
  S45 (858,781) col E / right end of the bottom rail (not critical): left at the default junction - the rail simply terminates on the column.
  All other sites (S3,S4,S5,S7,S9,S10,S11,S12,S15,S16,S25-S28,S30,S32-S35,S37,S39) are caption text ('8V','1KHZ','5V','9uF','4uH','3A','15uF') or symbol ink (capacitor plates, inductor coils) touching a wire. They do not change the netlist and were left at the default.

CLASSES: all 17 accepted as annotated. I specifically re-examined #9 (Diode at 870,638) at 8x because its bar looked hooked in the montage - it is a plain straight cathode bar with an up-pointing triangle, i.e. a Diode, not a Zener. #2/#5/#10 do carry the bent Z-bar and the '5 V' caption, consistent with Zener Diode. #1, #4, #11, #12 are plain diodes. No 3-terminal parts in this drawing, so no pin-order questions.

UNRESOLVED: nothing. All judgement calls above are backed by pixel-level crops; the only genuine override (S21) is supported by the geometry of the 4uH inductor bounding box. ERC clean, no single-terminal nets.
